1005.description: A standing crunch with a band, curling the torso forward. It trains the abs.
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with both hands and bring it up to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Engage your abs and slowly crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the crunch, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
用双手握住弹力带并将其举至胸前，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前挺胸，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在卷腹的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1069.description: Rotate your torso against a cable. It works the obliques.
instructions: Stand sideways to the pulley and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the stack.
Return slowly.
Switch sides.

1133.description: A one-arm strap row with the elbow flared, aimed at the rear shoulder.
instructions: Hold one handle and lean back at an angle.
Keep your hips level and free hand on your chest or hip.
Pull the handle toward your shoulder with the elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear delt at the end.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1197.description: The basic bodyweight squat. It trains the thighs and glutes and teaches solid lower body mechanics.
instructions: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can while keeping your heels down and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

1261.description: A decline cable press for the lower chest. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine to a decline position.
Sit on the decline bench facing the cable machine.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position them at chest level.
Keep your feet flat on the ground and your back firmly against the bench.
Exhale and push the handles away from your body, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, squeezing your chest muscles.
Inhale and slowly return the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将拉线机调整至下降位置。
坐在面向缆绳机的下降长凳上。
正手握住手柄并将其置于胸部水平。
将双脚平放在地面上，并将背部牢牢靠在长凳上。
呼气并将手柄推离身体，充分伸展双臂。
动作结束时暂停片刻，挤压胸部肌肉。
吸气并慢慢地将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1325.description: A wide grip pulldown where the bar travels behind your neck. It works the lats and upper back but needs good shoulder mobility and control.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the pulldown bar is at a height above your head.
Sit down on the seat and grab the pulldown bar with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your chest up as you lean back slightly.
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整缆绳机，使下拉杆位于您头部上方的高度。
坐在座椅上，用宽的正手握法抓住下拉杆。
稍微向后倾斜时，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
将杠铃向下拉至上胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃释放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1389.description: A seated stretch that opens the inner side of the lower leg. It targets the posterior tibialis along your shin and ankle.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Loop the rope around the ball of your foot and hold the ends of the rope with your hands.
Gently pull the rope towards you, flexing your foot and stretching your calf muscles.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the tension on the rope and relax your foot.
Repeat the stretch on the other leg.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将绳子绕在脚掌上，并用手握住绳子的末端。
轻轻地将绳子拉向自己，弯曲脚并伸展小腿肌肉。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
释放绳子上的张力并放松脚。
在另一条腿上重复该拉伸动作。

1453.description: A seated machine twist that trains the trunk rotators and abs against a controlled load.
instructions: Sit on the machine, adjust the pads and place your arms or hands as designed.
Sit tall with your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side with a smooth, controlled turn.
Pause briefly, then return to the centre without letting the weight stack slam.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.

1517.description: The explosive pull of a clean, finished with a shrug and without the catch. It builds power and bar speed.
instructions: Set up over the bar with a flat back and a grip just outside your knees.
Lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close.
Extend your hips and knees explosively and shrug.
Let your elbows rise high, but do not catch the bar.
Lower the bar with control and reset.

1581.description: A lunge where you step back instead of forward. It is gentler on the knees and focuses on the glutes.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel planted.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side first.

1645.description: A two-arm cable curl on an incline bench. The incline puts the biceps in a stretched position.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the cable handles with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the handles towards your shoulders while contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在倾斜的长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地面上。
反手握住电缆手柄，手掌朝上，手臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将手柄向肩膀弯曲，同时收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将手柄放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1709.description: A partner-assisted stretch lying down for the glutes. It eases the hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Bend your right knee and place your right ankle on your left thigh, just above the knee.
Grasp your left thigh with both hands and gently pull it towards your chest.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，双腿伸展。
弯曲右膝盖，将右脚踝放在左大腿上，就在膝盖上方。
用双手抓住左大腿，轻轻地将其拉向胸部。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒。
松开并在另一侧重复。

1773.description: A one-arm row using a towel while hinged forward. Trains the upper back and builds grip strength.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a towel with one hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Extend your arm fully, allowing the towel to hang in front of you.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the towel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖微曲，单手握住毛巾。
腰部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
完全伸展手臂，让毛巾挂在您面前。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将毛巾放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1837.description: Lengthens the extensor muscles at the back of the neck by tucking the chin down.
instructions: Sit tall with your back straight.
Tuck your chin toward your chest.
Rest one hand on the back of your head and add very light pressure down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Remove your hand and lift your head slowly.

1901.description: A floor stretch that opens up the inner thighs while you rest face down on your forearms.
instructions: Kneel on a mat, then lower your chest and forearms to the floor.
Slide your knees wide apart and sink your hips back toward your heels until you feel the inner thighs stretch.
Keep your breathing slow and stay relaxed, without bouncing.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1965.description: A seated stretch pulling the toes back to lengthen the bottom of the foot.
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the toes with your hand.
Gently pull the toes back toward your shin.
Feel the stretch along the sole of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2093.description: A seated wrist stretch for the inner forearm and the little finger side of the wrist.
instructions: Sit tall and extend one arm forward with the palm facing up.
Use the other hand to bend the wrist back and tilt it toward the thumb side until the forearm stretches.
Keep the elbow straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2157.description: A side lying leg raise against a band that works the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and lie on your side with your legs straight.
Rest your head on your arm and keep your hips stacked.
Raise the top leg against the band without rolling backward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

2285.description: A machine pullover that sweeps the handles toward you. Works the lats with a long range of motion.
instructions: Adjust the seat and handles of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grasp the handles with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms slightly bent and your core engaged.
Slowly pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your lats.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机的座椅和手柄调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在垫子上，并用正手握住手柄。
保持手臂稍微弯曲，核心肌群参与。
慢慢地将手柄拉向胸部，挤压背阔肌。
在收缩高峰时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2349.description: A side plank form check that compares a piked butt with a straight body line.
instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips off the floor.
Make a straight line from your head to your feet.
Avoid letting your butt stick out or your hips drop.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to stay level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2413.description: A curl where the bar drags up your torso with a wide grip, targeting the biceps.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with a wide underhand grip.
Keep your elbows pointing back and the bar close to your body.
Drag the bar up your torso by pulling your elbows behind you.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso upright.

2733.description: Lifting a thick axle bar from the floor to overhead. The fat grip makes it a brutal test for hands, forearms and shoulders.
instructions: Stand over the thick axle with feet shoulder width apart and grip it firmly.
Pull it up the thighs with a flat back and clean it to your chest.
Dip and drive with your legs, pressing the axle overhead until your arms lock.
Bring it back down to your chest and then the floor with control.

2797.description: A barbell squat, a small jump and a step back into a rear lunge. A demanding combo for leg strength and power.
instructions: Rest the barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down, then jump up lightly and land softly.
Step one foot back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep, keeping your chest tall.

2861.description: A seated twist that reaches toward the opposite foot, training the obliques and stretching the back of the legs.
instructions: Sit with legs wide and arms out.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Reach your hand past your opposite foot.
Return to centre.
Switch sides.

2925.description: Stepping up onto a bench with one leg while holding dumbbells. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a box or bench.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall.
Lower back down under control without bouncing off the floor foot.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

2989.description: A short flow of deep squat positions that opens up the hips, knees and ankles. Good as a warm-up before leg work.
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width and toes turned out slightly.
Sink into a deep squat and keep your heels on the floor.
Press your elbows against your knees to open the hips and hold for a moment.
Shift gently from side to side, then rock forward and back.
Stand up tall and repeat the flow for 6-8 rounds.
Keep your chest lifted and your back long throughout.

3117.description: A band pulldown with a close grip from an overhead anchor. Builds the lats and biceps.
instructions: Attach the band to a fixed point above you, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Sit down on a bench or chair facing the band, with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Grasp the band with a close grip, palms facing towards you.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
Slowly release the band back to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将弹力带固定在您上方的固定点上，例如上拉杆或坚固的横梁。
坐在面向乐队的长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
紧紧握住弹力带，手掌朝向您。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
将弹力带向下拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，感受背阔肌的收缩。
慢慢地将弹力带释放回起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。

3181.description: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together, taking glute work to the next level.
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped open.
Bring your heels close to your hips.
Drive your hips up by squeezing your glutes.
Pause at the top.
Lower and repeat in quick pumps.

3245.description: A seated stretch moving the feet side to side to loosen the ankles.
instructions: Sit with your legs extended.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Roll your feet slowly to the outside.
Then roll them inward.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

3309.description: A squat with the barbell racked across the front of your shoulders. The front load keeps you upright and hits the quads hard.
instructions: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high and hands steadying it.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and brace your core.
Sit down between your hips, keeping your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your whole foot and keep your elbows up the whole way.

3373.description: Drawing circles with the ropes toward each other. It builds shoulder endurance.
instructions: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn inward.
Keep the circles even and large.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Continue for a set time then rest.

3501.description: A forearm plank with alternating leg lifts. It builds core stability and glute strength.
instructions: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift one leg a few inches without rotating your hips.
Lower it and lift the other leg.
Keep your core tight and your hips level.
Breathe steadily.

3565.description: A deep backbend where you press up from the floor, opening the chest and hips and strengthening the back of the body.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat near your hips.
Place your hands beside your head, palms down, fingers toward your shoulders.
Press through hands and feet to lift your hips and chest.
Straighten your arms as far as is comfortable and relax your neck.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

3693.description: A light rotation exercise lying on a bench that strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles around the shoulder.
instructions: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in your top hand, elbow bent 90 degrees at your side.
Keep your elbow tucked against your ribs.
Rotate your forearm upward, lifting the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly back to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3757.description: A band chest fly from a high anchor, pulling downward to work the lower chest.
instructions: Anchor a band high and hold one end in each hand, facing away.
Step forward and lean slightly.
Bring your hands together in front of your waist with a soft elbow.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly.

3821.description: A crunch with your arms reaching toward your knees. It focuses on your upper abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Extend your arms straight toward your knees.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, keeping your arms reaching.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

3885.description: A skipping move where the rope passes twice under your feet for each jump, great for conditioning and coordination.
instructions: Hold the rope handles at your hips with your elbows close.
Stand tall and start with a few normal jumps.
Jump a little higher and spin the rope faster with your wrists.
Let the rope pass twice under your feet before landing.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your jumps small and your body upright.

4013.description: A lateral raise performed lying down using a crossing cable. It isolates the side delts.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a cable running across your body.
Hold the handle with the far hand.
Raise the arm out to the side.
Lower with control.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

4077.description: Alternating band presses from a low anchor. It trains the upper chest.
instructions: Anchor the band low behind you and hold both ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press one hand up and forward.
Return, then press the other hand.
Keep your core braced.

4141.description: A second version of the one arm overhead band extension.
instructions: Anchor or stand on the band and hold it overhead in one hand.
Bend your elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
Extend your arm fully.
Keep your core tight.
Switch arms after your set.

4205.description: Dips with a band looped around the bars to take some of your weight. It builds triceps and chest strength while you work toward unassisted dips.
instructions: Loop a band around the dip bars and set your knees or feet in it.
Grip the bars and straighten your arms with your chest up.
Lower your body until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows close and your shoulders down.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Use a thinner band as you get stronger.

4333.description: A bench reverse crunch where your knees trace a circle. It works the lower abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on a bench and grip behind your head for support.
Bring your knees up over your hips.
Curl your hips up and draw a small circle with your knees.
Reverse the circle on the next rep.
Lower your hips slowly each time.

4397.description: A split squat with the bar in a front rack position, building leg strength and core control.
instructions: Rest the barbell on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Take a split stance with one foot well in front of the other.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

4589.description: A straight lead-hand punch thrown at a partner holding pads, working speed and accuracy.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad at head height.
Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Throw your lead hand straight to the pad.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down.
Retract your hand quickly to your guard.
Keep your feet light and repeat.

4653.description: A supported single-leg drill that alternates a high knee and a heel kick, working balance and the hips.
instructions: Stand next to a wall or support and hold it with one hand.
Raise the opposite knee to hip height.
Lower it and kick that heel up toward your glutes.
Repeat smoothly for the reps.
Switch sides and keep your torso upright.

4717.description: A pull-up with a neutral staggered grip and some help, building back and arm strength.
instructions: Grip a bar with one hand in front of the other.
Use a band or feet for assistance.
Pull until your head passes the bar to one side.
Lower with control.
Switch the head side on the next rep.

4781.description: A seated chin-up where your legs help a little while you pull up with an underhand grip. It builds back and arm strength.
instructions: Sit under a bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your chin toward the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

4845.description: A floor press with kettlebells. The floor limits range and keeps the focus on the chest and triceps.
instructions: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in each hand at chest level.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press the kettlebells up until your arms are straight.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press again.

4909.description: A squat that starts with feet together and steps out to a wide stance. It trains the glutes and legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms in front.
Step one foot out to the side into a wide stance.
Sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand up and bring your feet back together.
Alternate the stepping side.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

4973.description: A biceps curl seated on a bench set to 70 degrees. The slight lean keeps the arms hanging for a good stretch.
instructions: Set a bench to 70 degrees and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up without moving your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back against the bench.

5101.description: Explosively pull one dumbbell from the floor to your shoulder. It builds power through the hips and legs.
instructions: Stand over a dumbbell with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down and grip it with a flat back.
Explode up through your hips and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and catch it at your shoulder.
Lower it back down under control, then switch arms.

5165.description: From a plank with your feet on towels, slide your feet in to lift the hips into a pike. It hits your abs hard and challenges shoulder stability.
instructions: Put your toes on towels on a smooth floor and get into a straight-arm plank.
Brace your abs and keep your arms straight.
Slide your feet toward your hands as your hips rise into a pike.
Pause briefly at the top.
Slide your feet back to the plank without letting your hips drop.

5741.description: A kneeling cable crunch that curls the spine toward the hips. It loads the abs against steady resistance.
instructions: Kneel below a high cable with the rope held beside your head.
Keep your hips still and your back slightly rounded.
Crunch down, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start without sitting back on your heels.

5805.description: A glute bridge with feet set wide and small pulses at the top. Burns the glutes with constant tension.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet wide apart.
Lift your hips to the top of a bridge.
Pulse your hips up and down in small, controlled movements.
Keep your glutes squeezed throughout.
Lower fully after your set.

5997.description: A push-up that starts from lying flat on the floor each rep, so every rep begins from a dead stop and builds pressing strength.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Push your body up into a straight plank.
Lower yourself all the way down until your chest rests on the floor.
Relax briefly, then push up again.

6061.description: A bent-over fly with bottles that targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, a bottle in each hand hanging below you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

6765.description: A neck stretch where your hand adds gentle pressure. It eases the side and back of the neck.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the side of your head.
Gently tilt your head toward the shoulder, using light pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Release slowly and switch sides.

7213.description: A light rotation exercise lying on your side that turns the arm inward. It strengthens the rotator cuff gently.
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your ribs.
Rest the forearm on the floor in front of you.
Rotate your forearm up toward your belly.
Lower it slowly back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

7277.description: Kneeling hip thrust against a band that targets the glutes without any bench.
instructions: Kneel with a band anchored low in front and looped around your hips.
Start with your hips back and chest up.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes hard.
Pause at full hip extension.
Return slowly and repeat.

7341.description: Side to side hopping that swings your legs like a pendulum, training balance and leg power.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to land on the other foot.
Swing the free leg across behind you for balance.
Land softly and stay controlled.
Keep alternating at a steady pace.

7469.description: Goblet squat finished with a calf raise as you stand.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to standing.
Rise onto your toes at the top.
Lower your heels and go into the next squat.

7597.description: A two-handed cable row from a high pulley with your chest braced on a pad. It trains the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Set the cable high and lean your chest against the support pad.
Grab the handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back and slightly down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let your arms extend slowly to the start.

8365.description: A band stretch that moves overhead and behind you, opening up the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Hold the band in front of your thighs with a wide grip and straight arms.
Stand tall.
Raise the band overhead and keep going back behind your body.
Reverse the path to return to the front.
Widen your grip if it feels too tight.

8621.description: A seated pec dec motion without a machine, squeezing the chest by bringing the forearms together.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your forearms in front of you with elbows bent at shoulder height.
Squeeze your forearms together.
Open them back to the sides under control.

8877.description: Opening your fingers against a band strengthens the small extensor muscles of the hand and forearm. It is a good balance for all the gripping you do.
instructions: Loop a light band around your fingers and thumb of one hand.
Rest your forearm on a table or your thigh.
Start with the fingers curled in a relaxed fist.
Spread your fingers open against the band's pull.
Close them back slowly with control.
Do all reps, then switch hands.

9325.description: A push-up held in place at the top or bottom. It builds chest, arm and core strength.
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower halfway down until your elbows are bent.
Hold the position for 10 to 20 seconds.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Press back up.
Rest and repeat.

9517.description: A dead bug done while holding a kettlebell overhead, adding load to the core challenge.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell above your chest with straight arms.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend one leg out while keeping your back flat.
Return it and alternate sides.

10093.description: A diagonal lift from low to high while half kneeling, working the trunk, hips and shoulders together.
instructions: Kneel in a half-kneeling position and hold a dumbbell near the outside of your back hip.
Brace your abs and keep your torso upright.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally up and across your body.
Finish with it above the opposite shoulder.
Lower along the same path.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

10541.description: Seated, you hug one knee toward your chest and bend it. It mobilizes the hip and knee gently.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Lift one knee and clasp your hands around the shin.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest and flex it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

10669.description: A seated press on an incline lever machine with a weight stack. It emphasises the upper chest.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at upper-chest height.
Sit back with your feet flat and shoulder blades pinched.
Press the handles forward and up until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly to a stretch across your chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

10733.description: A single-leg stand on a balance board. It trains ankle stability and control.
instructions: Place a balance board on a flat floor next to a wall for safety.
Step on with one foot and find your centre.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold steady for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your hips level.
Switch legs.

10861.description: Reverse hyper on a GHD, with a ball held between your feet. It trains glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie face down on the GHD with hips at the edge and a ball between your feet.
Hold the pad.
Lift your legs until they line up with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.

10925.description: A jump taking off from two feet and landing on one. It builds power and landing control.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and land on one foot.
Absorb the landing with a bent knee and hold steady.
Reset and alternate landing legs.

10989.description: A hold on parallettes with knees tucked and hips lifted. It builds shoulder and core strength.
instructions: Place your hands on parallettes and squat down.
Lean forward over your hands, arms straight.
Lift your feet with knees tucked toward the chest.
Hold for a few seconds, rounding your upper back slightly.
Lower your feet gently.

11053.description: A hip thrust on the Smith machine with a staggered stance. It builds the glutes.
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the bar over your hips.
Stagger your feet, one slightly ahead.
Drive through your heels.
Lift your hips to full extension.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and switch the stance.

11309.description: A one-arm pulldown on a plate-loaded machine using an underhand grip. It trains the lats and biceps one side at a time.
instructions: Sit in the machine and grab one handle with an underhand grip.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Pull the handle down, driving your elbow toward your side.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

0045.description: A bench press where the bar travels down to the neck area. A demanding variation for the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your neck, keeping your elbows pointed outwards.
Pause for a moment when the barbell is just above your neck.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
慢慢地将杠铃降低到颈部，保持肘部朝外。
当杠铃位于颈部上方时，暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0109.description: A standing overhead triceps extension with the barbell. Isolates the triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the barbell overhead, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then raise the barbell back to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃。
将杠铃举过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
保持上臂靠近头部，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后伸展双臂将杠铃举回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0173.description: Overhead cable triceps extension from a low pulley with a straight bar. It isolates the triceps, especially the long head, through a deep stretch behind the head.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine to a low pulley position.
Attach a straight bar to the cable.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip and extend your arms straight overhead.
Lean forward slightly, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将拉索机调整至低滑轮位置。
将直杆连接到电缆上。
背对机器站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住杠铃，并将手臂伸直过头顶。
稍微向前倾，保持背部挺直，核心参与。
弯曲肘部，将杠铃放低到脑后，保持上臂靠近耳朵。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0237.description: A straight-arm pulldown with a rope from a high pulley. Keep the arms nearly straight to isolate the lats.
instructions: Attach a rope to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with both hands, palms facing down.
Extend your arms fully in front of you, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your lats and slowly pull the rope down towards your thighs, keeping your arms straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索连接到最高设置的缆绳机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
双手抓住绳子，掌心朝下。
将手臂完全伸展到身前，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
收紧背阔肌，慢慢地将绳子向下拉向大腿，保持手臂伸直。
在底部停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0301.description: A dumbbell press on a decline bench. The angle emphasises the lower chest.
instructions: Lie down on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and extend your arms straight up above your chest, palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，双脚固定，头部低于臀部。
双手各握一个哑铃，双臂伸直至胸部上方，手掌朝前。
慢慢地将哑铃降低到胸部两侧，保持肘部呈 90 度角。
将哑铃推回起始位置，充分伸展手臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0365.description: Forearms rest over the end of a bench with palms facing in, and you move the dumbbells with your wrists. It builds forearm strength and grip.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Rest your forearms on the bench, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心朝上。
将前臂放在长凳上，让手腕悬在长凳边缘。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0429.description: Standing, you curl dumbbells with an overhand grip. It builds the muscle under the biceps and the forearms.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.

Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps. Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0493.description: You perform a push-up with hands elevated. It makes the push-up easier and trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Place your hands on an elevated surface, such as a bench or step, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the elevated surface by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将双手放在较高的表面上，例如长凳或台阶上，双手之间的距离略宽于肩宽。
将双腿伸到身后，放在脚掌上，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向升高的表面降低，保持身体呈一条直线。
在底部暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0621.description: A crunch combined with alternating leg scissors. It targets the abs and lower belly.
instructions: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Crunch your shoulders up.
Scissor your legs, crossing one over the other.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Switch which leg crosses on top each rep.

0685.description: A running style move that gets your heart rate up. Keep a steady pace for as long as you like.
instructions: Start by standing upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your upper body relaxed.
Begin jogging in place, lifting your knees up towards your chest and landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Maintain a steady pace and continue jogging for the desired duration or distance.
Remember to breathe deeply and maintain good posture throughout the exercise.
instructionsZh: 首先站直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
启动你的核心并保持上半身放松。
开始原地慢跑，将膝盖抬向胸部，然后轻轻落在脚掌上。
保持稳定的步伐并继续慢跑所需的时间或距离。
记住在整个练习过程中深呼吸并保持良好的姿势。

0749.description: On the smith machine, you bend your knees slightly and hinge forward with the bar on your upper back. Works the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to raise your torso back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾指向前方。
将杠铃放在上背部，放在斜方肌上。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
降低躯干直到与地面平行，感觉腿筋被拉伸。
启动臀肌和腿筋，将躯干抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0813.description: A triceps dip with the hands on one bench and the feet on another. It trains the triceps and shoulders.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your hands gripping the edge of the bench, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手抓住长凳边缘，手指指向前方。
将臀部滑离长凳，用手支撑体重。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持背部靠近长凳。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
